name: Jira Align
description: Jira Align is Atlassian's enterprise strategy and work-planning platform. Organizations use it to connect themes, portfolios, programs, teams, objectives, releases, and delivery work across people, work, and time hierarchies.
agentUseSummary: Connect a Jira Align tenant with an expiring scoped Atlassian API token, then let agents read authorized planning data and approval-gate supported creates and updates through REST API 2.0.

credentialRequirements.name: JIRA_ALIGN_SITE_URL
credentialRequirements.label: Jira Align site URL
credentialRequirements.helpText: Enter the HTTPS origin for your Jira Align tenant, such as https://example.jiraalign.com.

credentialRequirements.name: JIRA_ALIGN_EMAIL
credentialRequirements.label: Atlassian account email
credentialRequirements.helpText: Use the account email that owns the scoped Atlassian API token.

credentialRequirements.name: JIRA_ALIGN_API_TOKEN
credentialRequirements.label: Scoped Atlassian API token
credentialRequirements.helpText: Create an expiring Atlassian API token with Jira Align read scope; add write scope only when enabling management.

capabilities.label: Browse Jira Align
capabilities.description: Read authorized strategy, portfolio, program, team, work, time, customer, location, and idea resources.

capabilities.label: Manage Jira Align
capabilities.description: Create or update resources supported by Jira Align REST API 2.0 and the connected user's role.

allowed.label: Read Jira Align data
allowed.description: Run one bounded GET request against a documented Jira Align REST API 2.0 resource.

approvalRequired.label: Change Jira Align data
approvalRequired.description: Create or update one supported Jira Align resource; Safe mode requires approval.

blocked.label: Expose credentials
blocked.description: Atlassian API tokens and authorization headers never enter agent-visible results.

blocked.label: Call an untrusted route
blocked.description: Requests are pinned to the validated Jira Align tenant's HTTPS origin and Relay's allowlist of documented API 2.0 resources.

blocked.label: Transfer unbounded data
blocked.description: Relay bounds query fields, JSON request bodies to one megabyte, responses to ten megabytes, and refuses redirects.

approvalProfiles.label: Safe
approvalProfiles.description: Bounded reads run directly; every supported Jira Align create or update requires approval.

approvalProfiles.label: Dangerously skip permissions
approvalProfiles.description: Selected token-authorized creates and updates run without Relay per-action approval; provider roles, tenant pinning, route bounds, redaction, audits, and limits still apply.

runtimeSupport.description: Railway mounts bounded read and approval-gated management wrappers for documented Jira Align REST API 2.0 resources.
Railway mounts bounded read and approval-gated management wrappers for documented Jira Align REST API 2.0 resources.

providerSetup.blocker: No customer Jira Align tenant, scoped Atlassian API token, representative planning data, or authorized live provider session is available for production acceptance.
providerSetup.nextAction: A Jira Align customer creates an expiring Atlassian API token with read scope and least-privilege account role, connects the tenant in Relay Console, and verifies reads, Safe approval, optional write-scoped mutations, rate limits, redaction, disconnect, and post-disconnect denial.

evidence.supports: Atlassian documents Jira Align REST API 2.0, tenant-relative resource URLs, Basic authentication with Atlassian API tokens under Guard, independent read and write scopes, user-role authorization identical to the UI, the supported object families, and a 600-requests-per-60-seconds IP limit.
Jira Align documents bounded API 2.0 query operators including $select, $top, $skip, $filter, ordering, and expansion.
Jira Align documents authenticated GET usage, API 2.0 resource paths, URL-encoded filters, and a maximum of 100 records per response.
Atlassian documents scoped API tokens for Jira Align, revocation, and mandatory expiration between one and 365 days.
Atlassian describes Jira Align as enterprise strategy and work planning that connects business strategy to technical execution.
